strengths: Novel weight graph representation that preserves network topology rather than flattening weights, with principled design based on forward data flow through network architecture

Well-motivated functional loss (Eq. 4) for VAE training that measures output consistency rather than parameter similarity, addressing the insight that functionally similar weights may differ parametrically
Comprehensive experimental evaluation across 4 PDE systems and real-world ERA5 data with extensive ablation studies (weight representation, two-stage vs single-stage, component necessity)
Significant practical efficiency gains with ~3× faster test-time adaptation compared to meta-learning baselines and linear scaling of generator parameters with model size
Model-agnostic framework demonstrated on multiple architectures (FNO, UNO, WNO) with good extrapolation and unseen equation generalization results
Thorough robustness evaluation including permutation invariance, extrapolation, and sensitivity to observation length, plus statistical significance testing
Excellent explainability analysis (Figures 7-9) showing attention patterns align with network hierarchy and interpretable feature extraction from observations
weaknesses: Statistical significance issues: improvements on Lambda-Omega system are not significant (p=0.15 in-domain, p=0.53 out-domain); Kolmogorov only approaches significance (p=0.016 out-domain), undermining core claims

Catastrophic unexplained failures of baseline methods: D2NWG and CVAE fail 50-400× worse on some systems (e.g., CVAE achieves 4.454 RMSE on Kolmogorov vs 0.077 for DynaDiff); no investigation of whether this reflects unfair comparison, implementation bugs, or hyperparameter tuning disparity

Theoretical analysis in Appendix G makes unvalidated assumptions (particularly Assumption 1 on Functional Lipschitz Continuity) and uses auxiliary loss as informal 'tractable surrogate' rather than rigorously justified component; bounds don't account for model zoo construction

Fundamental limitation of fixed architecture generation not addressed despite acknowledgment; method cannot adapt architecture to environmental complexity, restricting applicability compared to alternatives

Model zoo design choices poorly justified: 100 models appears arbitrary with limited ablation; domain-adaptive initialization affects learned joint distribution but treated as implementation detail rather than fundamental design choice

Prompter design concerns: hand-crafted physical features (mean, variance, energy, enstrophy) lack sensitivity analysis; Table 13 shows minimal difference using actual vs. learned environment, suggesting prompter may not be learning substantively

Inconsistent baseline comparisons with extreme performance variance across methods and systems not explained; raises concerns about experimental setup consistency or fair implementation of competing methods
